source_snapshot.procedure: When the system is off, POST Redfish ComputerSystem.Reset with `ResetType: On`; source embeds credentials in the URL, disables TLS verification and says to clear logs before test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Redfish response is readable, correct and error-free.
source_snapshot.script: Private power-on; 30 attended and 30 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes Reset(On) and IPMI post-state but uses insecure TLS/credential handling and lacks target-off, approval, recovery and boot-readiness gates.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; verify isolated target is off, secure supported action, immediate approval, independent monitoring, Redfish/IPMI/POST/OS evidence, no blind retry or automatic power-off.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes the host-state change and post-state check but does not control duplicate/unknown completion or verify the required initial state.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly gates the automatable POST and observations on explicit human authority and an independent recovery path.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Reset(On) is conditionally meaningful only from a verified off state. If the system is already on, a success response cannot cover the transition intent; if POST acceptance is ambiguous, only independent state reads may resolve it before any further action.

original_test_intent: Verify that one authorized isolated SUT transitions from confirmed off to operational on state when the supported Redfish Reset(On) action is issued once under explicit approval.
original_method: Prove exact target and off pre-state through Redfish and IPMI, confirm maintenance/workload authority and independent console recovery, obtain immediate approval, issue one secure supported Reset(On) POST, monitor task/power/POST/boot progress without retrying ambiguity, verify OS readiness within the approved window, and preserve all logs.
manual_activity: The system owner verifies the intentional off state, maintenance window and workload impact, explicitly approves the power-on POST, observes the independent console and directs any recovery if boot does not complete.
required_inputs: Vendor Reset(On) schema and firmware support
safety_requirements: Never target an unidentified or non-isolated system
Do not issue On when already on
Use trusted TLS and secret-safe sessions
Do not auto-reset or auto-power-off on failed boot
Preserve full response and boot evidence
agent_execution_scope: Validate action support and recovery path
engineer_actions: Decide whether any recovery action is separately authorized

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Reset(On) matches the requested transition, but `-k`, command-line secrets and absence of initial-state, single-issue, independent-monitoring and boot-readiness controls make the example unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After protected Redfish/IPMI reads prove the exact target is off and the owner approves, POST one vendor-supported `ResetType: On` through a trusted authenticated session; independently monitor power, POST and OS readiness without blind retry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The off-to-on intent and 30/30-minute window remain; generic log clearing and any automatic cleanup power action are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a transition timeline linking off-state proof, approval, POST response/task, Redfish/IPMI state, console POST milestones and final OS health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds pre-state proof, safe authority, independent observability and an operational end-state rather than accepting an HTTP response.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful POST cannot prove the host began booting, completed POST, reached the intended OS or avoided a repeated action after unknown completion.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power-on may start workloads and expose latent boot failures. This case does not authorize repair, reset, firmware changes or later power-off.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define what constitutes operational readiness, allowed transition time and who owns recovery. If only chassis-on is intended, that narrower oracle must be explicitly approved rather than inferred from the source's no-error criterion.
expected_evidence: Target/resource identity, isolated off-state proof, action support and approval
Trusted TLS/auth/client metadata with secrets redacted
Complete POST response/task and one-command audit
Console POST/boot and OS readiness within the approved timeout
Preserved SEL/system logs, recovery decisions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and procedure consistently require powering on from off. The response-only criterion is incomplete but does not specify an incompatible outcome; boot/OS evidence completes the transition oracle.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target isolation, secure action support, approval and console access are obtainable project inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if off pre-state, authority or independent recovery cannot be proven.

review_improvement: Converts an insecure one-line POST into a single-authorized, observable off-to-operational transition with explicit ambiguity handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: A power-on request has at least four states: rejected, accepted but not energized, energized but failed POST, and operational. The source's HTTP success criterion distinguishes none of the latter three. Correlated Redfish/IPMI, console and OS evidence is therefore required, with no retry until independent reads resolve unknown completion.
